cq_coverage.1: EDIFACTMessage (or InvoiceMessage) is composed of InvoiceMessage instances via containsMessage and hasSection; invoices are InvoiceMessage instances contained in an EDIFACTMessage.
cq_coverage.2: Organizations involved are linked via hasOrganization (InvoiceMessage->Organization), and more specifically via RoleAssignment and involvesOrganization.
cq_coverage.3: RoleAssignment (pivot class) links an Organization to its AgentRole within an InvoiceMessage (via hasRoleAssignment, involvesOrganization, hasAgentRole).
cq_coverage.4: RoleAssignment with hasAgentRole=Buyer identifies the buyer organization for a given invoice.
cq_coverage.5: Organization is linked to Address, Identifier, GlobalLocationNumber, and AgentRole through hasAddress, hasIdentifier, hasGlobalLocationNumber, and RoleAssignment; all info about organizations is available via these properties.
cq_coverage.6: The address of the buyer is obtained by following RoleAssignment (hasAgentRole=Buyer) to the Organization, then hasAddress.
cq_coverage.7: LineItem (in InvoiceDetailSection) is linked to Item via hasItem; items sold are instances of Item associated with LineItems of the invoice.
cq_coverage.8: Item is linked to Price, Quantity, and other attributes via hasNetPrice, hasQuantity, etc. All info about items is accessible via these properties from LineItem.
cq_coverage.9: Net price of items is expressed via hasNetPrice (LineItem->Price), and Price has value as a data property.
cq_coverage.10: Invoice details are captured in InvoiceHeaderSection (reference numbers, dates, etc.), InvoiceDetailSection (line items), and InvoiceSummarySection (totals, tax).
cq_coverage.11: Invoice amount is represented as hasInvoiceAmount (InvoiceSummarySection, xsd:decimal).
cq_coverage.12: Invoice number is a data property (hasInvoiceNumber) of InvoiceHeaderSection.
cq_coverage.13: Mandatory info for file format validity is modeled via SHACLConstraint, EDIFACTDirectory, and hasMandatoryIdentifier; constraints and required identifiers are captured as properties.
cq_coverage.14: Business process assignment is modeled via hasBusinessProcess (InvoiceMessage->BusinessProcess).

notes: Ready to generate the initial OWL ontology in Turtle syntax. The ontology will include all planned classes, properties, hierarchies, EDIFACT-specific technical vocabulary, and detailed annotations. All prefixes and ontology declaration will be included. Every class and property will have rdfs:label and rdfs:comment. Data properties will use only allowed OWL2 DL datatypes. Pivot class RoleAssignment will be used for reification of Organization+Role+Invoice context. Detailed axioms and restrictions will be added for advanced modeling, including property characteristics and restrictions as per the plan.

pitfall_details.desc: Missing owl:inverseOf for all object properties

iterations.notes: First validation: syntax is valid. Pitfalls detected: (1) ReferenceNumber class is unconnected; (2) No owl:inverseOf for object properties; (3) Naming inconsistency for EN16931_1 and CompositeDataElement. Will address by: (a) connecting ReferenceNumber (as data property or remove as class); (b) adding owl:inverseOf for all object properties; (c) unifying naming to CamelCase without underscores for all classes.

refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review of expert feedback and previous context identifies the following high-priority issues: (1) OWL 2 compliance: The data property :hasDate uses xsd:date, which is not OWL 2 DL compliant; must change to xsd:dateTime. (2) Missing rdfs:label and rdfs:comment on some properties (e.g., :hasOrganizationPlayingRole and possibly others). Medium priority: (3) Add at least one General Class Inclusion (GCA), e.g., a ValidInvoice class defined by restrictions (header, detail, summary, validation constraint). (4) Expand disjointness axioms to cover more technical classes (Segment, CompositeDataElement, SimpleDataElement, Delimiter, etc.) for better separation. Low priority: (5) Consider modeling code lists via SKOS or individuals for technical completeness. Plan: 1. Change :hasDate range to xsd:dateTime. 2. Audit all properties for missing rdfs:label/comment and add as needed, especially for :hasOrganizationPlayingRole and any others. 3. Add a ValidInvoice class as a GCA/equivalentClass with necessary restrictions. 4. Add more disjointWith axioms among technical classes (Segment, CompositeDataElement, etc.). 5. If time, add a stub for code list modeling (as SKOS or individuals). Preserve all correct structure and relations, only modify where needed.
